description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the ImmutableEnforcementFilter class within the Eclipse Ditto project. The tests verify immutability, equality, placeholder processing, header enforcement, and exception scenarios related to enforcement filtering in connectivity models.

classes.name: ImmutableEnforcementFilterTest
classes.description: JUnit test suite for the ImmutableEnforcementFilter class testing immutability, equality, placeholder substitution, header enforcement, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of ImmutableEnforcementFilter are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode() and equals() methods in ImmutableEnforcementFilter.

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderPrefixed
methods.description: Tests placeholder substitution at the beginning of the placeholder string.

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderPostfixed
methods.description: Tests placeholder substitution at the end of the placeholder string.

methods.name: testSimpleEntityIdPlaceholderAndEntityIdFilter
methods.description: Tests substitution involving entity ID placeholders.

methods.name: testSimplePolicyIdPlaceholderAndEntityIdFilter
methods.description: Tests substitution involving policy ID placeholders.

methods.name: testSimpleEntityIdPlaceholderAndEntityIdFilter
methods.description: Tests substitution involving default namespaced entity ID placeholders.

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderPreAndPostfix
methods.description: Tests placeholder substitution with prefixes and postfixes.

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderPreAndPostfixFails
methods.description: Ensures failure occurs when placeholder substitution does not match the expected entity.

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderWithUnresolvableInputPlaceholder
methods.description: Verifies that an UnresolvedPlaceholderException is thrown for unresolvable input placeholders.

methods.name: testSimplePlaceholderWithUnresolvableMatcherPlaceholder
methods.description: Verifies that an UnresolvedPlaceholderException is thrown for unresolvable matcher placeholders.

methods.name: testDeviceIdHeaderMatchesThingId
methods.description: Checks enforcement when device ID header matches a ThingId.

methods.name: testDeviceIdHeaderMatchesPolicyId
methods.description: Checks enforcement when device ID header matches a PolicyId.

methods.name: testDeviceIdHeaderMatchesEntityId
methods.description: Checks enforcement when device ID header matches an EntityId.

methods.name: testThingSearchFilter
methods.description: Tests enforcement behavior with a Thing search subscription and event, ensuring mismatched IDs cause enforcement failures.

methods.name: testDeviceIdHeaderEnforcement
methods.description: Helper method to test enforcement with device ID headers for various ID types.
